entries.educational_text_no: Institusjonen åpnet i 1891 under navnet Neevengården sinnssykeasyl.
entries.educational_text_en: The institution opened in 1891 under the name Neevengården sinnssykeasyl.

entries.educational_text_no: I 1927 ble navnet endret til Neevengården sykehus. «Asyl» falt bort.
entries.educational_text_en: In 1927 the name changed to Neevengården sykehus. The word for asylum was dropped.

entries.educational_text_no: I 1978 fikk sykehuset navnet Sandviken sykehus — et stedsnavn, ikke en diagnose.
entries.educational_text_en: In 1978 it became Sandviken sykehus — named for a place rather than for what happened inside it. Three names in eighty-seven years, each one moving further from the last. The building did not change. What we were willing to call it did.

entries.educational_text_no: Idéen om en bane opp Fløyen ble foreslått i 1895.
entries.educational_text_en: The idea of a railway up Fløyen was proposed in 1895.

entries.educational_text_no: Selskapet A/S Fløibanen ble stiftet i 1912.
entries.educational_text_en: The company A/S Fløibanen was established in 1912.
Fløibanen opened on 15 January 1918. Twenty-three years from idea to opening — and from that day the mountain was something anyone in Bergen could get to, not only those who could climb it.

entries.educational_text_no: Femte generasjon vogner ble satt i drift 1. april 2022. De heter Rødhette og Blåmann.
entries.educational_text_en: The fifth generation of cars entered service on 1 April 2022. They are called Rødhette and Blåmann. You have just walked up what they climb in eight minutes. Both ways of arriving are the point.
